annotation.authors_or_issuer: Republic of Korea (National Assembly; Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport)
annotation.venue: Korea Legislation Research Institute (KLRI) English statutes
annotation.summary_en: Korea's Motor Vehicle Management Act (amended Mar. 2024) governs vehicle registration, safety standards, self-certification, defect recalls, inspection and management businesses. It includes provisions on autonomous vehicles (temporary operation permits for testing, incident reporting), connected vehicles, software updates, accident recording devices and mandatory vehicle cybersecurity management system certification.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines autonomous vehicle and connected vehicle; autonomous test vehicles need temporary operation permission with safety requirements, reporting and suspension orders
Manufacturers must self-certify vehicles and parts against safety standards; core devices such as traction batteries require safety certification
Mandatory certification of motor vehicle cyber security management systems and reporting of cyber attacks (Arts. 30-9 to 30-12)
Manufacturers must disclose and correct defects, with recalls and compensation; defect presumption rules
Accident recording devices must be installed and data provided to owners
